name: Breadboard Builder
description: Place schematic components on a virtual breadboard and validate wiring against the KiCad netlist.
description_full:
A KiCad Action Plugin for introductory analog electronics courses.

Students draw a schematic in Eeschema, then use this plugin to wire up the same circuit on a virtual breadboard — placing components, drawing jumper wires, and validating their work against the schematic.

Features:
- Six configurable breadboard sizes (mini to triple)
- Parses KiCad netlists; shows all placeable components in a side tray
- Supports resistors, capacitors, diodes, LEDs, BJTs, JFETs, MOSFETs, op-amps, and more
- Validate wiring against the schematic (open nets and shorts)
- Export to PNG or SVG
- Save/load board sessions (.kicad_bbrd)
- Instrument probes: function generator, oscilloscope, PSU
